title: observability: automate Prometheus/Grafana, log shipping, dashboards and alerts for Private installs
author: Aisha Patel
description: Motivation: Provide an automated, auditable observability stack for Private (VPC/on-prem) installs so customers get production-grade metrics, dashboards, and logs out-of-the-box while preserving the ability to route telemetry to customer-managed backends. What this PR does: 1) Helm: adds an optional 'observability' umbrella chart with subcharts for prometheus-operator (kube-prometheus-stack), grafana (with provisioning), and vector/fluentd for log shipping. 2) Terraform: adds a 'monitoring' module to the private-installer terraform pipeline to create namespaces, RBAC, and (optionally) a managed persistent volume claim for Prometheus TSDB. 3) Dashboards/alerts: ships a curated set of Grafana dashboards (k8s overview, ingress/egress, model-serving latency, inference-pipeline SLOs) and Prometheus alerting rules with parameterized receiver templates so customers can wire to email/pagerduty/slack/ops endpoints. 4) Log shipping: vector configuration templates that support outputs to HTTP/Elasticsearch/OpenSearch/S3 and an option to keep logs local only. 5) Upgrade/rollback: Helm pre-upgrade checks and post-upgrade health probes; automated rollback on probe failure. 6) Installer UX: new CLI flags and installer-config.yaml keys (observability.enabled, observability.backend, observability.alerts.enabled) with validation and docs. Compatibility: everything is opt-in by default and uses the same RBAC/service account model as existing components; no breaking changes to current installs. Migration: a migration path is documented (see docs/observability-migration.md) to bootstrap the new monitoring module into existing clusters. Testing: manual end-to-end validation on k3s and AWS EKS dev clusters, unit tests for template rendering, and integration smoke tests added to CI. Checklists: - [x] Helm charts added and linted - [x] Terraform module and examples - [x] Grafana dashboards included - [x] Alert templates and receiver examples - [x] Documentation and quickstart - [x] E2E smoke tests Notes: initial CI had a linting failure for a Prometheus rule (fixed in commit 3). We keep observability components disabled unless the installer-config explicitly enables them to avoid surprise resource creation. Recommended rollout: enable in staging first with a limited scrape/retention policy, validate alert semantics, then enable in production with tuned retention and storage class. Related: ENG-4218, SRE-88.

release_notes: Adds an opt-in observability stack for Private installs: Prometheus (kube-prometheus-stack), Grafana with curated dashboards, configurable log shipping via Vector/Fluentd, Terraform module for monitoring namespace/bootstrap, and automated Helm upgrade/rollback hooks. Opt-in by default; see docs/observability-migration.md for migration steps.
